purpose: Re-audit the fixed three-local-session A-share frontier after the terminal monetary-funds capacity rejection and select at most one economically independent, reproducible source mechanism without inspecting a new provider row, announcement title, factor value, price, or return.

research_scope.quality_gate: ROE at least 5 percent, positive net profit, positive revenue YoY, and positive profit YoY under the existing point-in-time quarterly-quality policy

prior_terminal_evidence.result: The sole no-return audit retained 9,839 quality/listing-eligible factor rows but only 114 of the required 200 complete non-overlapping three-session cohorts. Comparison fields, prices, and forward returns were not loaded.

source_selection_evidence.provider: Eastmoney public announcement API as documented by the pinned AKShare adapter

candidate_review.reason: The income and fina_indicator statement-version routes have already terminated on undocumented company-type, non-standard report-period, or incomplete required-row evidence. Selecting rd_exp after those failures would replay the source interpretation and continue a financial-field sweep after the profitability and cash-conversion families were closed.

The official cyq_perf interface currently requires at least 5,000 points, while the authorized account has 3,000. No request, purchase recommendation, factor value, or substitute price-derived approximation is permitted in this iteration.

The official stk_auction_o and stk_auction_c pages identify separate product permissions rather than the existing points entitlement. Auction data remains attractive for a three-session strategy but cannot be assumed available or purchased without a separate user decision.

A newly disclosed government subsidy is a dated external-support catalyst rather than price path, order flow, ownership, leverage, earnings composition, accounting cash conversion, valuation, analyst attention, or generic related-party complexity. A strict title rule and count-complete public announcement transport can be frozen before any title is observed.

selected_mechanism.economic_mechanism: Among quality-eligible issuers with a newly observed government-subsidy announcement, a larger number of qualifying notices disclosed more recently represents a stronger and fresher external-support catalyst that may be incorporated over the next three local sessions.
selected_mechanism.source_event_measure: government_subsidy_announcement_count = count of globally unique complete art_code values for one supported instrument and one notice_date whose normalized title passes the frozen inclusion and exclusion rules
selected_mechanism.multiple_active_events: use only the latest qualifying notice_date that is already effective; a later event supersedes an older event when the later event becomes effective
selected_mechanism.units: qualifying notices divided by one plus calendar-day age
selected_mechanism.title_normalization: Unicode NFKC, trim leading and trailing whitespace, and collapse internal Unicode whitespace to one ASCII space; no tokenization, semantic model, synonym expansion, issuer-name removal, or manual correction
selected_mechanism.title_match_rule: include when the normalized title contains at least one required literal and no excluded literal
selected_mechanism.valid_event: art_code, notice_date, normalized title, and codes are complete; exactly one supported main-board or ChiNext A-share code is present; notice_date lies inside the requested partition; the title passes the frozen literal rule
selected_mechanism.invalid_event_policy: abort on malformed required transport structure, ambiguous multiple supported A-share codes, duplicate instrument/notice_date/art_code keys, out-of-partition dates, changing pagination totals, incomplete pages, or a response above the frozen page ceiling; exclude and count complete unsupported-board records and nonmatching titles; never infer, fill, manually relabel, or inspect announcement bodies
selected_mechanism.availability: first local trading session strictly after notice_date
selected_mechanism.absent_event_policy: missing; never zero support, a favorable score, or an all-market ranking value

mechanism_independence.versus_financial_statements: No revenue, profit, R&D amount, asset, liability, cash-flow, margin, report-type, company-type, or revision-value field enters the event formula. Quarterly fundamentals remain eligibility only.
mechanism_independence.versus_dividend_repurchase_and_contract_: A subsidy is external public support, not a shareholder distribution, issuer-funded repurchase, or customer-funded demand contract. Those event counts and freshness measures remain mandatory no-return semantic neighbors.
mechanism_independence.versus_related_party_and_governance_even: Related-party clustering measures governance complexity. The candidate uses only subsidy-title classification and announcement identities; it requests no counterparty, relationship, transaction amount, or control flag.
mechanism_independence.versus_analyst_survey_and_attention_even: No broker, analyst, survey participant, rating, forecast, research-report count, or target-price field enters the formula. Generic event freshness and count remain mandatory synonym checks.
mechanism_independence.versus_price_volume_and_level2: No OHLCV, VWAP, turnover, market capitalization, valuation, classified flow, order, trade, queue, depth, price, or return field enters source acceptance or factor construction.

required_gate_order: freeze the exact public endpoint, category, title literals, normalization, identity, pagination, sample windows, formula, direction, timing, invalid-row policy, acceptance thresholds, future capacity, and uniqueness rules before any announcement row or title

implement and locally test page-count reconciliation, recursive pre-page bisection, strict transport normalization, title classification, duplicate rejection, point-in-time universe filtering, sample variation checks, one-shot guards, and atomic publication
run exactly one no-price source acceptance over the frozen historical samples and permanently consume it whether it passes or fails
if and only if acceptance passes, freeze a fingerprint-bound full-source and no-return preregistration before requesting any remaining 2019-2025 partition
run capacity before comparison fields or prices, and semantic/statistical uniqueness before any factor return
freeze a separate one-time return and execution diagnostic only if every no-return gate passes
prohibited_actions: request or persist security names, announcement bodies, URLs, subsidy amounts, subsidy accounting classification, issuing agency, issuer financial values, price, market cap, valuation, return, credential, cookie, proxy, or retail-session data
expand or edit the title literals, use fuzzy matching, a language model, announcement-body text, subsidy amount, industry residual, or another category after seeing rows
treat a nonmatching or absent announcement as zero, a favorable value, or evidence that no subsidy occurred outside the contracted public category

invert the direction, widen the three-calendar-day age, change the latest-event rule, alter samples, lower source/variation/capacity/uniqueness gates, or rescue a failure with another field or provider
read prices or returns, aggregate with terminal factors, current-score, select, size, order, or justify Level-2 before all later no-return gates pass
